title: Short-Term Anticoagulation versus Antiplatelet Therapy for Preventing Device Thrombosis Following Left Atrial Appendage Closure. The ANDES study.
official: Short-Term Anticoagulation versus Antiplatelet Therapy for Preventing Device Thrombosis Following Left Atrial Appendage Closure. The ANDES study.
summary: Main objective: To compare the incidence of device thrombosis following LAAC between patients receiving short-term (8 weeks) anticoagulation therapy (DOAC) vs. antiplatelet therapy
conditions:
Atrial Fibrillation
Device thrombosis post-Left Atrial Appendage Closure

interventions.name: Dabigatran Etexilate GLN 150 mg hard capsules
Apixaban Teva GmbH 5 mg filmdragerade tabletter

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients undergoing successful LAAC with any approved device
2. Age≥18 years old
Exclusion criteria:
1. Absolute contraindications for AC therapy
2. Absolute contraindications for antiplatelet therapy
3. End-stage renal disease (CrCl <15 ml/min)
4. Recent percutaneous revascularization with drug-eluting stents necessitating dual antiplatelet therapy
5. Prior intracranial hemorrhage
6. Contraindications for TEE
7. Severe pericardial effusion within the first 24 hrs following LAAC
8. Major/life-threatening bleeding within the first 24 hrs following LAAC
